purpose: limited exploratory comparison of fixed metadata and historical measured voltage-span proxy against one controlled DC test

B_DS.fit: none; datasheet value may contain reserve/warranty convention

B_HIST_SPAN.fit: none; no offset current, SOH scaling, calibrated OCV or efficiency fit
B_HIST_SPAN.fallback: unavailable, retain target event and failure status

reference: published first controlled test; feature builder cannot use its numeric values for eligibility or selection

metrics.reporting: one event per supported output; report availability/failure for every model, no uncertainty interval, significance or accuracy claim
metrics.common_comparison: B_NOM vs B_HIST_SPAN capacity; B_NOM/B_DS/B_HIST_SPAN energy only where predictions exist; unavailable predictions are never dropped silently

boundaries: history anchors are recorded-voltage proxies, not guaranteed full/empty states; natural low-rate intervals and maximum-power tests differ; internal BMS/balancing drain may be unseen; no causal or VPP commitment claim
test_usage: known reference used only for declared retrospective comparison, not independent confirmation
implementation_status: frozen design, not implemented or evaluated yet
change_control: no threshold/lag/loss/endpoint search after scoring; new method means new protocol
